review_method: Final read-only source audit of src/run_experiment.py, src/optimized_validation.py, runpod/screen.py, runpod/screen_remote.py, and runpod/paired_benchmark.py. No tests, cloud calls, or resource mutations were performed for this review.

measurement_and_validation.consumer_gate: collect(optimized=True) requires a passing full_technical optimized-validation receipt, collection_candidate approval, full coverage, the exact required checks, identical executor, exact v2 execution mode, requested context/layers/plan/source-review identity, and the frozen tolerances. Legacy v1 receipts therefore cannot authorize this candidate executor.
measurement_and_validation.measurement_cleanup: measure_input removes capture hooks/forward overrides before an independent uninstrumented native forward; both baseline NLL and logits must match exactly before any complete event is returned. A failed cleanup raises before collection can append events.
measurement_and_validation.independent_validator: _input_case first captures an untouched native baseline, then separately captures the shape-preserving contribution baseline and checks them with the pre-existing tolerances. It compares all optimized interventions against independent native full-forward ablations with the same routing/survivor/downstream-route checks, then requires exact final cleanup against the native baseline and verifies parameters and hooks are unchanged.
measurement_and_validation.science_and_tolerances: No change observed to the token-local zero-contribution intervention, full-shape suffix replay, target definition, selected contexts/layers, ATOL=1e-6, RTOL=1e-5, or NLL_ATOL=1e-6. The independent validation performs additional reference forwards; the production measurement path retains baseline plus exact cleanup while avoiding repeated full-model forwards for optimized interventions.
measurement_and_validation.assessment: No blocking source-fidelity, math, durability, or consumer-gate failure found in the reviewed paths.

bounded_user_run_controller.paid_action_boundary: Preflight is read-only; cloud creation occurs only after explicit --run. Paired mode requires explicit finite remaining-cash and remaining-wall arguments, bounded by $12 and 36,000 seconds.
bounded_user_run_controller.attempt_ceiling: At most $0.40 and 1,200 seconds, further limited by reconciled operator balances, actual catalog rate plus a $0.02/hour storage allowance, and an assumed $0.03 fixed-cost bound. The deadline includes create, boot, staging, cached-weight verification, benchmark work, retrieval allowance, and intended teardown margin.
bounded_user_run_controller.identity_and_volume: Controller verifies archive hashes/sizes and protected current-source hashes, pins the digest-qualified runtime image, uses the existing registry and network volume, requires pod read-back to match the attempt, and terminates only the exact attempt pod while retaining the volume.
bounded_user_run_controller.remote_helper: For paired mode it requires and verifies source, screen, and baseline archives; checks the uploaded helper hash and candidate implementation identity; extracts the preserved baseline separately and checks its implementation identity; refuses incomplete cached model files and invokes read-only model verification instead of model acquisition; and launches the paired benchmark within the bounded deadline. Hashing each extracted file is bounded, and an explicit cutoff check prevents cached-weight work from starting late; however, extract_checked receives preflight_cutoff plus the 30-second reserve and its post-extraction sha256_file check uses that full argument, so that hash can run up to 30 seconds past the nominal startup/preflight cutoff. The extracted-file hash check now uses deadline minus FINAL_RESERVE_SECONDS, matching the tar-member inspection cutoff; a subsequent explicit check also prevents weight work from starting after the startup/preflight cutoff.
limits_and_assumptions: The $0.03 fixed-cost bound and hourly storage allowance are planning assumptions, not an invoice quote or provider-enforced spending limit.

There is no provider hard TTL in the reviewed controller. Teardown is actively attempted and guarded, but a provider/API failure can prolong pod billing beyond the nominal cash/time cap; the result must not be described as a hard provider-enforced cap.

The 50 GB user network volume is intentionally retained and may continue to incur its existing storage charge beyond the pod attempt window; the nominal per-attempt allowance does not bound its future lifetime cost.
bounded_user_run_controller.minor_usability_gap: The dry-run message currently prints `python runpod/screen.py --run` without the required --remaining-cash-usd and --remaining-wall-seconds arguments, so that example is rejected for paired mode.
bounded_user_run_controller.fixed_during_final_review: The extracted-file hash verification cutoff discrepancy was fixed in the v5-bound helper; the startup/preflight cutoff now applies consistently to archive inspection and extracted-file hashing.

paired_benchmark_adapter.identity_and_selection: The adapter loads the preserved baseline implementation into a private package namespace after strict hash parity for shared dependencies, checks frozen baseline/candidate implementation hashes when declared, validates the six fixed input identities and their plan rows, preserves matched 2048 suffix identity, alternates the frozen AB/BA schedule, and records plan/source review identities.
paired_benchmark_adapter.independent_checks: The adapter taps routes from the native baseline call by replacing src.interventions.RoutingCapture before _input_case imports it. The independent validator compares candidate suffix replay with actual native full-forward ablations, including route/coefficient bytes, mixtures, logits, NLLs, downstream routes, and exact cleanup. Paired raw events are compared against these independent native route/case references; numerical tolerances remain 1e-6 absolute, 1e-5 relative, and 1e-6 NLL.
paired_benchmark_adapter.counts_and_namespace: Success requires 12 measured pairs, six independent inputs, 48 measured events, 12 warmup events, and 60 total journal events. Receipt is explicitly paired-collector-diagnostic / diagnostic_only, with scientific_collection_authorized=false. The remote helper succeeds only on status=pass; the adapter emits pass only after the count gates and final model cleanup/parameter version checks.
paired_benchmark_adapter.durability_and_progress: Progress, event and timing JSONL writes flush/fsync; status and final receipt use atomic writes. Arm start/completion and native input progress are visible. The final paired-comparison summary and paired-arm completion progress include end-to-end duration through timing-row fsync. The timing sidecar row itself is appended before its own fsync duration is known; it records the prior end-to-end duration and explicitly labels that scope as excluding timing/progress sidecars. This is a disclosed scope distinction, not an evidence-integrity blocker.
fixed_during_review: The private optimized_validation._TimeLimit is explicitly classified as an incomplete bounded stop alongside TimeoutError.
Parameter versions are captured before measurement, checked after every arm and globally, and parameter_versions_unchanged is set only after those checks.
Cleanup checks decoder hooks, expert hooks/forward overrides, and post-attention normalization hooks.

finding.issue: The earlier status-classification gap is fixed. _is_incomplete_timeout recognizes the validator private _TimeLimit type as well as TimeoutError, so a bounded validator deadline is recorded as incomplete rather than fail.

paired_benchmark_adapter.phase_timing_note: Receipt finalization is timed before journal recount/hash/metadata work and checked against a 30-second cap with a 2-second receipt-write reserve and absolute-deadline reserve. If the check fails, full_coverage is cleared and a passing state is downgraded to incomplete before receipt writes. The final two atomic writes are covered by the reserved interval rather than included in the measured phase duration.
paired_benchmark_adapter.reported_tests: Coordinator reported runner-focused tests at 54 and the broader focused suite at 66 before final full-suite verification; this reviewer did not run tests.

hardware_context: 125 GB host RAM and 16 vCPU were reported as observed prior-host specifications, not a binding allocation contract. The reviewed request/readiness gate intentionally requires at least 64 GB host RAM, one L40S, pinned CUDA/runtime, and the selected region/volume; it does not assert 125 GB/16 vCPU.
conclusion: The final reviewed measurement-path cleanup reference, consumer authorization gate, numerical comparisons, identity checks, pair counts, and diagnostic-only namespace are coherent and preserve the accepted scientific operation and tolerances. The previously identified bounded-time classification, parameter-version, cleanup-hook, finalization-cap, startup/preflight-cutoff, and dry-run command issues are resolved in the current sources. Timing-sidecar scope and non-provider-enforced spend assumptions remain explicit limitations. No cloud attempt was made; coordinator-reported local and CPU differential checks are recorded above. The latest read-only stock check found no L40S availability in US-MO-1, so launch feasibility is currently blocked by capacity.
